details:
Q1. What exactly should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow, script, or file — name the exact target (RECOMMENDED)
B. A pipeline phase behavior — clarify / plan / implement / review / validate / orchestrate
C. Documentation only
D. Other — describe the exact repo area
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug/regression — include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new capability
C. Change wording/output/UX without changing core behavior
D. Refactor/cleanup only with no intended behavior change
Q3. What should planning use as the success criterion?
Choices:
A. A failing workflow run, PR, issue, or log that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. Exact before/after behavior or text you want
C. A concrete acceptance rule or checklist the change must satisfy
D. Best-effort improvement with no specific example
